leadText: Volume 18: The Warriors Gather is the eighteenth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the fourth of eight volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.
plainText:
Volume 18: The Warriors Gather is the eighteenth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the fourth of eight volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

==Blurb==
Ruby arrives in Verdanturf Town ready to participate in his first Hoenn region Pokémon Contest. It looks like his dream of becoming the Pokémon Contest Champion is finally back on track! But soon he gets sidetracked yet again when he is asked to rescue a Trainer from a Rusturf Tunnel collapse. Could Team Magma be behind this latest unnatural disaster...?

Then, both Ruby and Sapphire begin a losing streak...

Meanwhile, the Hoenn Gym Leaders can’t agree... Which group is evil? Team Magma or Team Aqua...or both?!

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 215 - Assaulted by Pelipper II
Chapter 216 - Mixing It Up with Magcargo
Chapter 217 - Mind-Boggling with Medicham
Chapter 218 - It's Absol-lutely a Bad Omen
Chapter 219 - What Would You Do for a Whismur?
Chapter 220 - Going to Eleven with Loudred & Exploud I
Chapter 221 - Going to Eleven with Loudred and Exploud II
Chapter 222 - Short Shrift for Shiftry
Chapter 223 - I More Than Like You, Luvdisc I
Chapter 224 - I More Than Like You, Luvdisc II
Chapter 225 - Tanks, but No Tanks, Anorith and Lileep
Chapter 226 - I Dare Ya, Altaria... Knock Chic off My Shoulder!

==Major events==
 
Tabitha helps Flannery in her attempt to revive Mt. Chimney.
defeats Flannery.
participates in, and wins, Normal Rank Pokémon Contests in all in categories.
Ruby meets Wanda.
Team Magma blow the Rusturf Tunnel up.
Courtney asks Ruby to join Team Magma.
The Gym Leaders hold a crisis meeting in Fortree City.
Ruby participates in Super Rank Pokémon Contests.
Ruby meets Wallace and becomes his student.
Ruby and Sapphire encounter one another again.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
None

===Evolutions===
Sapphire's "Chic" evolves into in PS226.

==Gym battles==
Sapphire battles Winona in PS226, but loses.

==Pokémon Contests==
Ruby wins Normal Rank Pokémon Contests in all categories in PS217.
Ruby wins Super Rank Pokémon Contests in all categories in PS223.
